item.description:
Prompt Light 1.1.3 adds secure automatic updates.
## Added
- Prompt Light now checks for updates automatically and can install them in place. - A **Check for Updates…** command is available from the menu bar. - General Settings shows the installed version and an update action. - Update archives and the update feed are cryptographically signed.
## Upgrading from 1.1.1 or 1.1.2
Those versions did not include an updater, so 1.1.3 requires one final manual download. Future releases can update automatically from 1.1.3 and later.
## Requirements
- macOS 14 Sonoma or later. - Apple silicon or Intel Mac. - Codex for automatic activity updates.
The app is signed with a Developer ID certificate and notarized by Apple.
